tasks.title: Conversation #56
tasks.transcript:
Man: I'm so excited for the outdoor concert this weekend.
Woman: Have you seen the weather forecast? We get soaked.
Man: Well that's disappointing. I was really looking forward to going.
Woman: Same here. Any thoughts on what to do instead?
Man: I heard there's a new exhibit opening on Saturday at the art gallery. Tickets go on sale tomorrow.
Woman: Count me in. We can meet up for breakfast that morning too.

questions.stem: What does the woman imply when she says, "Have you seen the weather forecast"?

options.A: That local weather reports are frequently inaccurate
options.B: That the forecast will change before the weekend
options.C: That she does not want to go to the concert
options.D: That she does not know what the weather will be like

questions.analysis: 答案：C 题目问的是：她提到天气预报是什么意思？ 定位原文：We get soaked 前一句说到：你看天气预报了吗？后一句说到：太让人失望了。说明天气不好，所以他们不能去户外音乐会了。 选项分析： A. 天气不准。未提及。 B. 会改变。未提及。 C. 不想去音乐会，因为下雨。根据上下文推理此选项正确。 D. 不知道天气。错误。

questions.stem: What will the man and woman most likely do this weekend?
questions.analysis: 答案：A 题目问的是：他们周末做什么？ 定位原文：new exhibit… art gallery 选项分析： A. Visit a museum（画廊）符合，因此正确。 B. 艺术拍卖。错误。 C. 音乐会。取消。 D. 在家听音乐。未提及。
